title: feat(plugin-timeline): object-timeline is judged and publishes the ten spec keys its renderer honours (objectui#11168 slice 5)
body:
Refs #11168

Clause-②: yes (narrowing). The `object-timeline` and `view:timeline` registrations publish ten more inputs (`timeline`, `limit`, `data`, `items`, `dateFormat`, `rowLabel`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `descriptionField`, `mapping`), and `objectName` is no longer required, so the page validator accepts timelines it used to report. Two values the spec row refuses are now reported where they were not, and that is the narrowing: a `dateFormat` outside `short` / `long` / `iso` is an `invalid-enum` error (it was an `unknown-prop` warning), and a `data` that is not an array is a `type-mismatch` warning (it drew nothing). No schema face changes. The fixed group ships it as `minor`.

objectui#11168 slice 5. objectui#11111 decision 3 = B applies (record `5902351047`): every key is decided by its own measurement through the real `SchemaRenderer`, and only what the renderer honours is declared. Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01VhxTqosz7wn54ahqyxgERT` (dispatched by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat, claim `5943159100`). `Refs`, not a closing keyword: the card's three waiting entries (`endpoint` ×2, `undoable`) stay booked.

## What this PR takes

| Item | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Load and judge | The parity guard eager-imports `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`; `object-timeline` joins `MINOR_17_5_LOADED_BLOCKS` and its OWED row in `UNJUDGED_SPEC_BLOCKS` is struck, the last of the four |
| The ten unpublished row keys | All ten measured honoured and declared, on both tags through one shared list, `OBJECT_TIMELINE_INPUTS` |
| `objectName: required` | Dropped on both tags: `items`, `data` and a `bind` path draw with no object |
| `sort` description | No longer opens with "Entry order": the rail draws composed entries by start date whatever the key says |
| Member pins | Eight registered: six in the new `objectTimelineInputs-11168.test.tsx`; `navigation` is booking (c), `timelineNavigationMembers-8654.test.tsx`; `dataSource` promoted from `ObjectTimeline.elementDataSource.test.tsx` after an end-to-end read |
| Ledger | By census: caps `unjudgedBlocks 0 / offSpecInputs 0 / unpublishedKeys 3 / refusedArms 0 / memberPins 0`, owner `objectui#11168` 3 (the three waiting entries); census 39 judged + 7 propless + 9 ledgered = 55 |
| kanban / calendar wording | Their `navigation` descriptions said `openNewTab` "outranks the mode"; they now say every mode except `none`, pinned both ways |
| `ObjectTimelineProps.navigation` JSDoc | States the measured mechanism (below) |
| Mirrors | No edit owed (H7 below) |
| Docs | The timeline README and docs page describe the record source order and each key; the `8220` changeset gets a dated note |

## Measurements (before any edit, on the unchanged renderer)

Predictions were written to files before each probe ran; every row came out as predicted. The probes were throwaway files, never committed.

**Census.** With only the import added, the guard went red on 8 rows: the reverse direction listed exactly the ten keys; the member-pin direction listed `filter`, `sort`, `navigation` and `dataSource`, in its per-block row and in the member-census partition row (the second was not in the prediction; it is the same fact read twice); and five census and ledger rows moved, as predicted. The forward direction, the arm judge and the member-kind judge stayed green.

**Each key**, authored in the spec's `properties` bag, through `SchemaRenderer` into the real `ObjectTimeline` and `TimelineRenderer`, in en-US:
- record source: `objectName` alone queried `evt` with `$top` 100; `items` alone and `data` alone drew with zero queries, on both tags; `data` or `items` beside `objectName` drew with zero queries; `items` beside `data` won; `data` beside a `bind` path won, and the `bind` path alone drew its rows with zero queries.
- `limit`: 5 gave `$top` 5, absent 100, and 0 gave 100 plus one console warning naming `limit: 0`.
- `dateFormat`: absent and `short` printed `1/5/2024`, `long` `January 5, 2024`, `iso` `2024-01-05`, on the horizontal rail and on entries composed from records too.
- `rowLabel`: headed the gantt's row column; absent, the column read `Items`; the feed rail drew it nowhere.
- `minDate` / `maxDate`: derived `Feb 2024`; pinned `2024-01-01` to `2024-03-01` gave three months; an empty value stayed derived; `whenever` and an inverted pair each refused the chart with the named diagnostic.
- `timeline`: `startDateField` / `endDateField` / `titleField` gave the date, `1/5/2024 → 1/9/2024`, and the title; `groupByField` headed groups `open` / `closed` (date buckets without it); `colorField` painted `#ff0000` from a colour literal and `#123456` from a select option's colour; each member outranked the flat key composed beside it; `titleField` / `startDateField` outranked `mapping`'s `title` / `date`; `scale: 'week'` drew `Week 1` to `Week 3` on authored gantt rows, where no `scale` drew `Feb 2024`.
- `mapping`: `title` / `date` drew `K-1` and its date with no `timeline` block, and outranked the flat keys; `description` outranked `descriptionField`; `variant: 'kind'` turned the markers emerald and amber, where the record's own `variant` field turned them red and purple; a resolved `colorField` colour outranked it.
- `descriptionField`: `summary` drew `Sum one`; absent, the `description` field was read.
- `sort`: `$orderby` carried the authored order; an adapter answering latest-first still drew `Kickoff` before `Review`.
- `filter` beside `data`: both records drawn, zero queries.

**The page validator**, live registry manifest, at the base and at the head (index taken back to the base under a trap, then restored):

| Node | Base | Head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` only, either tag | `missing-required-prop` (error) + `unknown-prop` | none |
| `dateFormat: 'medium'` | `unknown-prop` warning | `invalid-enum` error |
| `data: { x: 1 }` | none | `type-mismatch` warning |
| `limit: '5'` | `unknown-prop` warning | `type-mismatch` warning |

**The kanban / calendar wording (H5)**, through each block's own `NavigationMembers-8652` harness: `{ mode: 'none', openNewTab: true }` opened nothing on the board, the calendar and the timeline, and `openNewTab: true` beside each of `drawer`, `modal`, `split` and `popover` opened the record page in a new tab and no overlay, on all three. The hook checks `mode === 'none'` before `openNewTab`.

## Zone 2 hypotheses, as measured

- **H1 (loading)** held: one eager import judges the block in both directions.
- **H2 (the ten keys)** held at base `9547063da`: the same ten, all honoured. Nine row describes are true of the renderer and open their descriptions word for word, pinned against the installed row, and so does `objectName`'s. `descriptionField`'s describe ends "it is the only spelling this binding has", and `mapping.description` is a second spelling that outranks it, so its description keeps only the describe's first sentence (open question in the report).
- **H3 (`objectName: required`)** held: items-only, data-only and bind-only timelines draw, so `required` is dropped. The bare `timeline` key resolves to `view:timeline`, the same renderer under a second tag; the guard does not judge that tag (the spec carries no row for it), and it follows the same rule through the shared list, the `filter` / `sort` / `navigation` precedent in the same file.
- **H4 (booking (c))** held: the `object-timeline.navigation` row points at `timelineNavigationMembers-8654.test.tsx`, which gains the `none` + `openNewTab` row and the three missing overlay rows.
- **H5 (kanban / calendar wording)** held: the sentence was false for `none` on both blocks. It sat in their registrations only; their READMEs, docs pages and the guard's `MEMBER_PINS` notes do not carry it. The two notes now also name the new rows.
- **H6 (the JSDoc)** held as booked: "the hook then resolves the spec's `page`" was the wrong mechanism. Under a host navigator, an absent key opened nothing while a mode-less `{ size: 'lg' }` opened the record page through it (`openRecord('evt', 1)`): the absent key takes the hook's no-config branch, which calls only an `onNavigate` the timeline never passes. The JSDoc and the read-site comment now say so, and one pin row holds the pair.
- **H7 (mirrors)** falsified: no edit owed. `@object-ui/types` has no TypeScript face of this node, and `ObjectTimelineBlockSchema` takes the 17.5.0 row by reference (objectui#10859 batch 3), so `objectui validate` already accepted items-only and data-only timelines (pinned).
- **H8 (ledger)** held, read off the guard's own census rows: `unjudgedBlocks` 0, owner `objectui#11168` 3.

## Reverse verification

Committed first (`364216878`), then `packages/plugin-timeline/src/index.tsx` was taken back to `9547063da` (blob `2a898b3e759a`, `OBJECT_TIMELINE_INPUTS` count 0, `required: true` count 2) and the new pin plus the guard ran. Predicted and observed: exactly 8 red (the pin's two `declares every row key` rows, its two `page validator accepts` rows, its describe-prefix row and its `descriptionField` row; the guard's `object-timeline publishes every top-level key` and `every member pin names a key that is still array/object-armed`), 306 green. Restored from `HEAD` by absolute path under a trap: blob `5992b594bd69` equals `HEAD`'s, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Sources are vitest-aliased, so there is no `dist` leg.

## Gates

Final head `7364c4449`, through objectstack's `os-verify-lock.sh`:
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...`: 34/34, VERDICT command-exit 0. Scoped doc build (`check-doc-snippet-types --build-filter`): 35/35.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`, `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` (each `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, the touched pins in their programs by `--listFiles`) and `@object-ui/console`: exit 0, script names echoed.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-timeline/ packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/plugin-calendar/`: 165 files passed, 1392 tests passed, 129 skipped. `vitest run apps/console/`: 139 files, 1613 tests passed. Fifteen outside readers of these registrations (the schema catalog gallery, the app-shell block config, the html-page lazy blocks, the public tier, the CLI validate ratchet, the sdui-parser tier and manifest, the types timeline faces, the list and view timeline bindings, the form row-limit pin, two script pins): 15 files, 827 passed. Those three runs were at `e068eedce`; the last commit adds one assertion to the new pin and the `8220` note, and at `7364c4449` `vitest run packages/plugin-timeline/` plus the guard and the two navigation pins gave 45 files, 829 passed, 34 skipped, with the plugin-timeline type-check exit 0.
- Exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `new-line-citations` (0 new), `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence` (9 source files of 4 released packages, 3 changesets), `check-changeset-overwrite` (3 added, 1 modified: the dated `8220` note, its 2673-byte prefix identical by `cmp`), `doc-fences`, `doc-snippets` (775 of 775), `doc-examples`, `doc-types`, `doc-example-ids`, `doc-example-readers`, `readme-exports`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `component-surface-parity` (no `object-timeline` or `view:timeline` row), `element-data-source-declaration`, `test-path-roots`, `vi-mock-specifiers` / `inherit` / `override-shape`, `installed-pin-claims`, `prompt-keys`, `registry-bare-names`, `unreferenced-sources`, `comment-mask-corpus`, `spec-symbols`, `shell-escape-residue`, `handler-key-reads`, `i18n-keys`.
- `changeset-claims` asked for one pending body to be re-read, `8067`, which names the guard's path; its paragraph is the `page:header.actions` history and still holds.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED (control `AGENTS.md` exit 3).
- Lint, a declared narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 9 touched TS files gave 9 files, 0 errors, 58 warnings, none on a line this PR adds. Each file resolves under `--print-config`, and the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins` (prerequisite: a console bundle). Its subject is the registrations a `sideEffects` array keeps; this diff touches no `sideEffects` array and no import graph.

## Acceptance notes

- **`descriptionField`'s spec describe (open question in the report).** The installed row says the key "is the only spelling this binding has"; the same row's `mapping` describe lists a `description` member read ahead of the flat fallbacks, and the renderer reads `mapping.description` first. The description here states the measured order and keeps only the describe's true first sentence.
- **`timeline.scale` default (noted, not filed).** The spec's `TimelineConfigSchema.scale` carries `.default('week')`; with no `scale` the gantt branch draws by month (`resolveTimelineScale`). On this block only authored gantt rows read it, and no producer was found writing a `timeline` block beside authored rows. The description states what `scale` does and claims no default.
- **`apps/console` is test-only** here, so it carries no changeset, as on slice 4.
- **Not this PR's:** the three waiting entries (`endpoint` ×2, `undoable`); slice 4's three carried gantt items; objectui#11355's items; `skills/**`.
